speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; have you noticed if the baby is feeding well and peeing normally?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Breastfeeding Jaundice). Given the normal weight gain, good feeding history, and clinical presentation, I am ruling out biliary atresia or significant hemolysis. If the total bilirubin level is >17 mg/dL or if jaundice persists beyond 2 weeks, please proceed to liver ultrasound and blood smear.
